_comment: Words the oracle-backfill §3c content policy has dropped (slur / explicit-sexual-content primary sense) and that must never be re-offered by oracle-plan.js --new. Append an entry here whenever a round drops a word per .claude/commands/oracle-backfill.md §3c, in addition to the per-run log line in server/logs/oracle-concerns.md (which stays the append-only history; this file is the planner's live exclusion set). Do not remove an entry unless the underlying det row's definitions changed such that the drop reason no longer applies.
